description: This steep trail winds it way through various forest types up to an alpine ridge with excellent views of Williston reservoir and the surrounding landscape. The full trail is an approximately 16km round trip with an elevation gain of 1150m, however hikers first reach an alpine bench at around 5.5km, and this can also serve as a good turnaround spot for an 11km round trip.
directions: Travel north (NW) of Mackenzie on the Parsnip West FSR. The site is located at ~50.5kms on the Parsnip West FSR.

stats.Closure: Site currently inaccessible due to washout at 41km on Parsnip West FSR. No estimated time of reopening.

title: Kimta Creek Trail
